description: Core stat system. Primary stats drive all derived stats. Resistances are percentage-based damage reduction by type.

str.name: Strength
str.description: Raw physical power. Governs physical attack damage and contributes to physical defense.

int.name: Intelligence
int.description: Mental acuity and arcane knowledge. Governs magic attack, magic defense, MP pool, and healing power.

dex.name: Dexterity
dex.description: Agility and precision. Governs speed, critical hit rate, and dodge chance.

sta.name: Stamina
sta.description: Endurance and toughness. Governs max HP, physical defense, and base resistances.

hp.name: Hit Points
hp.description: Total health. Character dies when this reaches 0.

mp.name: Mana Points
mp.description: Resource for abilities. Most abilities cost MP.

phys_atk.name: Physical Attack
phys_atk.description: Damage dealt by physical attacks and abilities.

mag_atk.name: Magic Attack
mag_atk.description: Damage dealt by magic attacks and abilities.

phys_def.name: Physical Defense
phys_def.description: Flat reduction to incoming physical damage.

mag_def.name: Magic Defense
mag_def.description: Flat reduction to incoming magic damage.

spd.name: Speed
spd.description: Determines turn order. Higher SPD acts first.

crit_rate.name: Critical Rate
crit_rate.description: Chance to land a critical hit (2x damage). Capped at 75%.

dodge.name: Dodge Chance
dodge.description: Chance to completely avoid a physical attack. Capped at 50%.

damage_formula.note: Physical damage is reduced by defense, then further by physical resistance. Magic damage is reduced by magic defense, then by elemental resistance.

resistances.description: Percentage reduction to incoming damage of that type. Each resistance starts at 0% and is increased by gear, buffs, and a tiny amount from STA. Capped at 75%.

stat_per_level: Each level grants primary stat points based on the class growth table. Derived stats are recalculated automatically.

equipment_stat_types.description: Items can grant primary stats (str, int, dex, sta), flat derived stat bonuses, and resistance percentages.
